rejected_texture_model.status: Private research only; absent from installed production
rejected_texture_model.rule: Keep two original neighbouring R or B values separate; two independently fitted green groups, same condition/tolerance and amplification limit 4. Complete component only; preserve previous HL6 admissions.
rejected_texture_model.limit: Censored-flat and phase-texture deliberately share exact RAW hashes but different green truth. All local regressions remain listed. Fit agreement cannot identify a spectral change hidden by clipping. These are analytic controls, not photographs or physical calibration.

memory.scope: Whole isolated benchmark process, includes source, render and SHA work; three renders after one warmup. Not decoder admission or pressure qualification.

native_comparison_to_LibRaw.scope: Decode-only timing includes broker input hash, XPC and transfer, excludes output hash, image analysis and disk reports. Warm OS caches; no whole-machine RSS, cold-start or physical camera accuracy claim.
native_comparison_to_LibRaw.conditions: Three warmups and thirty alternating AB/BA pairs per D750; same bundle, source bytes and WB. No other build/test/GUI/benchmark campaign concurrent. OS/thermal state uncontrolled. Full worker decode plus hash of input, XPC and transfer; output hash excluded.

native_quality.limits: Regions, phases and generated families are correlated; signed normalized RGB chroma is not DeltaE. Eight full photographic images remain identity checks. No new measured photographic reference or absolute colour accuracy claim.

residual_stage_diagnosis.method: Develop the exact analytical, unclipped CFA with the current demosaic and colour transform. This isolates a counterfactual response; it is not a recoverable image or a measured photographic reference. Differences of maxima are not an additive error decomposition.
findings: D750 p0 and D800 p2 shoulder cases amplify a very small clipped-sensor discrepancy: maximum sensor error changes from 0.000089049 to 0.005591631 and from 0.000108361 to 0.005726576. Most of their remaining interior RGB error is absent with ideal CFA.

D750 p2 and D800 p0/p2 curved-colour cases have nearly accurate recovered CFA but a remaining demosaic/colour response at the curved boundary; ideal-CFA interior maximum RGB errors remain about 0.184447, 0.122451 and 0.127992.

Other curved-colour and texture cases retain a substantial clipped-sensor error. An ideal CFA demonstrates the cost of lost samples, not that their reconstruction is identifiable. Absolute physical colour accuracy is not assessed.

qualification_notes: Hash guards initially stopped the laboratory after rustfmt changed only formatting in newly frozen helpers. Rebound guards to their formatted snapshots and verified all prior baseline records against the complete frozen nucleus.
New helper equivalence test and guard corrections followed the pre-holdout source freeze; no production arithmetic or selection change followed it.
Profiling used a five-second macOS sample of only the isolated benchmark, outside the terminal sandbox. Full GUI/Core Image/XPC tests also ran in the native context.
Private timing and native timing have different scopes and must not be combined. No pressure-memory, cold-start, Windows, measured sensor/LED or calibrated photography qualification.
